newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia police hold man over Italian woman's death.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia police hold man over Italian woman's death.

text.p: Tunisian police have arrested a man suspected of killing an Italian woman missing since 1995, Tunisian officials said on Friday.
Milena Bianchi, 21, disappeared in 1995 in the Cap Bon region, 50 km (30 miles) south of Tunis, where she was living with her family.
Officials said police recently found Bianchi's body and arrested a man who confessed to killing her. They said the man, identified by police only as Munir, was aged 18 in 1995.
